title: Argentinian Pancake with Caramelized Ananas
description: A sweet twist on traditional pancakes, featuring caramelized ananas and a hint of argentinian flair.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together warm and roasted.
Add pancake to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
While the pancakes are cooking, caramelize the ananas in a separate pan with a little bit of butter.
Assemble the pancakes by topping with caramelized ananas and a drizzle of kicked.
